data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-flag-deprecation-check.sh before the script exists (RED). Tests cover the gate that enforces a deprecation plan before allowing a new flag to be added.

## Test Cases
1. Planning-config.sh patch adding new flag WITH deprecation plan containing {plan_date, owner, replacement_key} → exits 0
2. Planning-config.sh patch adding new flag WITHOUT deprecation plan → exits 1 with structured error
3. Planning-config.sh patch with no new flag additions → exits 0 (no-op)
4. Deprecation plan document malformed (missing replacement_key) → exits 1

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-flag-deprecation-check.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-flag-deprecation-check.sh

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S7/T1 for known flag landscape)
data.title: T2: RED — Write test suite for flag-deprecation-check.sh
